faq.question: What flavors do you have?
faq.answer: We have 6 signature flavors: Classic Golden Butter, Aged Sharp Cheddar, Salted Caramel Gold, Fiery Sriracha BBQ, Cookies & Cream Dream, and Kyoto Matcha White Chocolate! Check our Shop page for details.

faq.question: How do I order?
faq.answer:
1. Browse our Shop and select your popcorn & flavor options.
2. Add items to your cart and proceed to Checkout.
3. Choose Delivery or Pickup and pick your preferred time.
4. Scan the QR code (GCash, Maya, or InstaPay) and upload your payment receipt.
5. We'll confirm your order and get it popping!

faq.question: What are your delivery fees & bulk discounts?
faq.answer:
We are strictly Order & Pickup! 🏪

FREE Delivery is available to selected areas only:
• Poblacion, San Juan, Abra
• Poblacion & Near, Lagangilang, Abra

For all other locations, please select Pickup at checkout.

faq.question: How do I pay?
faq.answer: We accept cashless QR code payments via GCash, Maya, and InstaPay (all bank transfers). Scan the QR code displayed during checkout, transfer the amount, and upload the screenshot receipt.

faq.question: What are your operating hours?
faq.answer: We pop fresh Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Orders placed after 8:00 PM are prepared early the next business day.

faq.question: Can I pick up my order?
faq.answer: Yes! Choose 'Pickup' at checkout and select your scheduled pickup time. Your freshly popped bag will be waiting for you.
